approval.scope: Official Polyfin 0.61.1 private LAN/VPN pilot only
approval.revocation: Revoke immediately when an upstream or Debian fix is available, the digest changes, the network perimeter changes, or a new unapproved finding appears.

provenance.decision: Official publisher and immutable GHCR digest are verified; no upstream Cosign or GitHub attestation is claimed. Promotion remains bounded by this T2 policy and complete Trivy evidence.

controls: Internal Gateway only; no external HTTPRoute or Cloudflare Tunnel
Cilium egress allowlist only; no world:443
Non-root UID 65532, read-only root filesystem, no capabilities, no service-account token
IPTV, Eclipse and unknown media hosts remain disabled until separately qualified
The CRITICAL libxml2 finding remains separately identifiable and is not hidden
